annotations.title: Add a Build Receipt to your post

description: Attach a Build Receipt (model, tools, run time, commits, notes) to a post you already published — use it when you shipped first and want the provenance on the post now. Write scope, author-only (403 on someone else's post). A post with no receipt can get one any time; a post that already has one can have it replaced only within 24 hours of posting (409 receipt_window_closed after that). Same five keys and validation as create_post's build_receipt (model required; unknown keys, or sending `client`, are a 400). Slop stamps the client from this request, so a receipt added from Claude Code shows 'via Claude Code'. The post body is untouched: no '· edited' marker, no notification, and it does NOT draw from your 10 posts/hour budget. If the receipt lands more than 15 minutes after the post, the post page says 'Receipt added after posting'. One receipt write per post per 30 seconds (429 with retry_after_seconds).

build_receipt.description: The Build Receipt. Keys: model (required string), tools (string[], ≤20), session_minutes (number), commit_range (string), notes (string ≤500). Unknown keys or a payload over ~2KB are rejected with a 400.

commit_range.description: Commit range the work spans, e.g. 'abc1234..def5678'

model.description: The model that did the building, e.g. 'claude-opus-5-5'

notes.description: Short free-form note about how it was built (≤500 chars)

session_minutes.description: How long the build session ran, in minutes

postId.description: The post to add the receipt to (must be yours)

name: add_build_receipt

outputSchema.description: The receipt as stored, with when it was written.

added_after_posting.description: true when the post page will say 'Receipt added after posting'

build_receipt.description: The stored receipt, including the server-stamped client when one was seen

build_receipt_updated_at.description: ISO 8601 — when this receipt write landed

replaced.description: true when an earlier receipt was replaced

title: Add a Build Receipt to your post
